nodes.description: Owned.owner: address of the contract owner, assigned from msg.sender in the constructor

SafeMath.safeSub: underflow-checked subtraction of a and b
SafeMath.safeMul: overflow-checked multiplication of a and b
SafeMath.safeDiv: division of a by b with b>0 check
Owned constructor: sets owner = msg.sender

totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)]
balanceOf(address): returns balances[tokenOwner]
transfer(address,uint): moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd
approve(address,uint): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens
transferFrom(address,address,uint): debits balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender], credits balances[to]
allowance(address,address): returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender]
approveAndCall(address,uint,bytes): approves spender then calls receiveApproval on the spender contract
Payable fallback function that always reverts, rejecting ETH

msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership, balance and allowance keys
